claim: In June 2009 Elpida Memory agreed to sell JPY 30 billion of securities to the government-backed Development Bank of Japan as part of a JPY 160 billion financial package that included public funds.
evidence: "Japanese chip-maker Elpida was thrown a 160 billion yen (US$1.7 billion) financial lifeline Tuesday, including public funds"; "will sell securities worth 30 billion yen to the government-backed Development Bank of Japan, which will also extend it a loan of 10 billion yen." (IndustryWeek/AFP, 30 Jun 2009)
